note:
Second independent instance, from the #2168 Step 9c gate (2026-08-18) — and it BROADENS the scope twice.

This task's observed instance is a skill-doc SIZE GRANDFATHER cap (SKILL.md 982,587 B vs a stale 980_400).
#2168 hit the identical mechanism with a DIFFERENT derived constant, and then again with a shape that is
not a workflow_lint.py constant at all.

INSTANCE 2 — .claude/rules/LESSONS.md vs _LESSONS_MAX_BYTES (same mechanism, different constant):
  merge-base e7b4e7dc0a4a : LESSONS.md 10203 B / cap 10205 -> consistent
  origin/main 3f130025c522: LESSONS.md 10452 B / cap 10492 -> consistent (main ratcheted both same-diff)
  #2168 branch tip        : LESSONS.md 10452 B / cap 10205 -> RED on bytes identical to origin/main
Family transitivity exactly as this task describes: .claude/rules/ has no FAMILY_OF entry so it forms its
own CLEAN family and synced; scripts/workflow_lint.py is family "lint", DIRTY because #2168's deliverable
IS a new workflow_lint.py check, so it was correctly withheld — and the coupled cap went with it.
Cost: 4 gate failures (test_check_lessons_index_passes_on_live_repo, test_lessons_budget_constants_sane,
test_workflow_lint_default_exits_zero, test_guard_lessons_edit.py::test_live_lessons_rewrite_allowed).
Note this instance reaches a THIRD file — the edit-time guard scripts/guard_lessons_edit.py — so the
blast radius is not confined to the lint binary's own tests.

INSTANCE 3 — the same family split OUTSIDE workflow_lint.py entirely (scope extension):
tests/test_issue2162_figures.py + tests/test_issue1739_pvsynth.py arrived from origin/main via the
SIBLING-ISSUE per-file sync leg, while their paired scripts/issue2162_run.py (+20/-7 on main) stayed at
merge-base because #2168's C2 sweep had touched it — so main's tests ran against pre-main scripts.
4 more failures. The #2208 import-satisfiability probe cannot catch this: collection SUCCEEDS; only
assertions fail. So the coupling gap is not specific to derived CAP CONSTANTS — it is any same-diff
coupled pair whose halves land in different sync families, including script/test pairs.

Suggested scope widening for this task: the fix should not be a hand-maintained list of cap constants.
Both instances share one predicate — "the sync moved half of a pair that main landed in ONE commit."
A candidate general check: for each file the sync would copy from origin/main, look at the main-side
commit(s) that last touched it; if any of those commits ALSO touched a file the sync is withholding,
WARN (or refuse) naming both halves. That catches size caps, leanness caps, and script/test pairs with
no per-constant registry.

RESOLUTION USED IN #2168 (works, and is merge-neutral): rather than patching the one constant, merge
origin/main into the issue branch (commit 985ff8e1bbff). That reconciles every split half at once —
cap 10205->10492, the withheld check_pre_split_review_guard (+227 lines) and scripts/pre_split_review_guard.py
whose absence was already emitting a stale-worktree WARN, and the advanced sibling script. Sole conflict
was tests/step9c_workflow_invariant_manifest.txt (both sides appended a registration), resolved as a UNION
with selector set-equality re-verified. Post-merge the 8 failures are green.
This may be the better general remedy than per-constant restores: the branch has to merge main at Step 10d
anyway, so doing it at sync time cannot introduce content the landing would not already take.

Filed from #2168 as corroboration; NOT a duplicate task, per the (target_file, fingerprint) dedup rule.
